_help: Which way is north in each zone, as [x, z] in world coordinates (the direction that is 'north' on the zone map). The compass HUD (Scripts/compass_hud.gd) measures the character's facing against it.
Lumora Outskirts: north is the +X axis (Lumora is north, the docks southwest); east is then +Z. Zones not listed use 'default' = Godot's forward (-Z).
